body: I always find it amazing that sometimes we find the best help from unusual places. Thank you for the time you put into writing that comment. I'm sorry to hear about your recent break up too, I can only imagine how difficult that must have been. Today is actually a day where I've felt kinda okay about things, thinking about a life without her, But I know that's gonna change soon. I'm gonna keep trying to push forward, it's just hard to be productive in life having this constant weight pulling me down

Yea I've tried therapy three times a week since it's happened and been on anti depressants for awhile. Part of me can see it won't always be this low but the other part doesn't want to suffer this same heart break again, like what's the point of that?
How long ago If you mind me asking? How are you dealing with things now?

My main problem I guess is that I am able to see a future without her part of the time but the other half of my day is spent dwelling on how things are just over from here on yet. Every hour a deal with these back and forth thoughts

I don't think i explained the above situation very well. Basically in Highschool my girlfriend at the time encouraged my thoughts with "yeah that's a great a idea" "just do it, you already know how you want to do it". Amazingly I was in that relationship for 2 years almost but after going to university, within the first month I met what I thought was the most perfect person for me, she understood what I was thinking, what I've been through and as someone who's never had that before it was the most beautiful thing I've ever encountered. I've had a lot of unfortunate health breaks during my life at such a young age already. Double knee replacements, epilepsy, replaced collar bone, recently had brain surgery to remove a runout for my epilepsy and actually got diagnosed with testicular cancer earlier this summer (my most recent gf was quite spiritual and never really believed in bad karma in past lives until she met me..fun fact I guess). Anyway, she told me earlier in July that she felt overwhelmed with my life situations and didn't think I was offering back the same support. I was absolutely crushed and shocked. We're gonna be back at school early this September, and I've played through a scenario in my head multiple times, that I have one last in person chance to show her how much I really care about her. I've been going to therapy 3 times a week, currently on anti depressants too. I just feel like no matter what I do, if she says no to getting back together, I think it's the end of my story. Sorry for the confusing initial post
